description: 水利署各項農業用水統計 [irrigation] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部水利署. 本資料集為每年委辦統計前一年度資料並產製一次，各標的用水之運用情形，長久以來皆為經建、水利相關單位及各學術研究單位所重視，為使政府對於各項用水量，能有明確之統計數據，以利於各項用水政策的訂定，及各界進行水資源規劃之參考，本水利署為提供大眾此項寶貴資訊，固定每年出版用水統計報告。 前揭統計年報之統計、編寫方式已沿用多年，近年來水資源開發及應... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部水利署. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json, xml. The portal shows 2026-09-18 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support irrigation network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
